build.script:
#!/bin/sh
cd ./src/fpga
container system start
container run --rm --memory 4g --platform linux/amd64 -t -v $(pwd):/build didiermalenfant/quartus:22.1-apple-silicon quartus_sh --flow compile ap_core.qpf
rbfrmake output_files/ap_core.rbf output_files/bitstream.rbf_r

clean.script:
#!/bin/sh
cd ./src/fpga
container system start
container run --platform linux/amd64 -t --rm -v $(pwd):/build didiermalenfant/quartus:22.1-apple-silicon quartus_sh --clean ap_core.qpf
